description: An arrangement timeline made for a whole screen: a bar ruler that seeks on the grid, a loop strip, a lane per track with clips to move between tracks, trim and fade on the grid, a cursor to put anywhere on a track, and a split at the cursor, a transport with play or pause, stop, loop, a metronome and a tempo and signature that keep the arrangement's musical positions, a playhead following its clock, and a navigator to zoom and scroll, open it at full size and the tracks take the screen
name: block-timeline
